_metadata.description: AI chat panel that proposes a refactor patch via resource-openrouter; user must explicitly accept.

requirements.title: Chat panel sends component source + inspector selection context to resource-openrouter
requirements.description: Chat panel composes a prompt from the current component's TSX, the active inspector selection (if any), and the user's instruction. The prompt is sent through `resource-openrouter`'s scenario CLI (or its Go client, but never raw HTTP) and returns a unified-diff patch suggestion.

validation.notes: Service test injects a fake openrouter client; asserts the prompt assembly and parses a stubbed diff response.

requirements.title: Patches are applied only on explicit user accept
requirements.description: The diff is rendered in a review panel. Accept writes the new content via the same PUT used by the editor (with version recording). Reject discards. No auto-apply path exists.

validation.notes: Component test asserts Accept triggers PUT and Reject does not; a code-review check confirms no auto-apply code path.
